thread:
alina: heads up  new hire in EMEA starts Dec 29. payroll says local law requires payout of accrued vacation at start-of-employment. how does that interact with our Dec 31 carryover cutoff?

jess (People Ops): good catch. local statutory payouts can override internal carryover. we need to check with Finance + Legal for country-specific treatment. please include contract terms and local policy link when you submit.

ben (Finance): usually if local law mandates payout at start, we pay out accrued balance and that amount is removed from the internal carryover calculation. this can change carryover eligibility, so we need the exact law citation. payroll will need employee country + start date.

marta (Legal): confirm country? if it's one of the countries with mandatory severance/payout rules, yes we must comply. send me the offer language and any statutory reference. also note tax withholding differences for payouts vs carryover.

alina: it's Portugal. offer language standard. start 2026-12-29. candidate asking whether they can bank the vacation to use after the shutdown or if they get paid out.

jess (People Ops): Portugal often requires payout on termination but not necessarily at hire. still, some local customs/contract clauses trigger accrual payouts. we'll need to verify. i'll open an exception ticket.

people-ops-bot: Action: "Open carryover-exception ticket with payroll/legal when local statute affects payout at hire." <https://hr.redwood.com/exception-ticket>

ben (Finance): payroll: please attach the candidate's national ID and employment contract copy. i'll run a payroll simulation for payout vs carryover treatment and share numbers.

marta (Legal): i'll lookup Portuguese labor code refs and advise. if contract language inadvertently creates a payout obligation we should update the template for future hires.

jess (People Ops): process note for the team: if local law forces payout at start and the payout occurs before Dec 31 cutoff, that payout stands and carryover won't apply. if we want to give a goodwill credit (e.g., allow banked hours in addition to statutory payout) that's an exception and needs manager + people-ops + finance sign-off.

alina: timeline? candidate expects an answer tomorrow afternoon.

ben (Finance): i'll run the sim this morning. expect a draft calc by 12:30pm PT.

marta (Legal): i'll have a short memo on statutory obligations and suggested offer language edits by 4pm PT.

jess (People Ops): i'll coordinate and draft a short exception request if needed. thanks team.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: "Country-specific payout obligations can affect internal carryover. Open exception ticket and include contract + payroll sim."
